verdict.rationale: Modal documents a public programmatic API for Sandboxes. This includes a Python SDK reference for `Sandbox` (exec, logs, snapshots, networking, resource parameters) and JS/Go SDKs for creating sandboxes and executing commands, backed by a documented CLI and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages). Community projects building on it corroborate that it is usable in practice. missing for 10: a published language-agnostic REST/OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths return 404), and a documented raw wire protocol (gRPC access is only community-reported).
